translationRepairs: During Wei's Zhenguang era, Mohe Chen Bajie overran the frontier garrisons, and Wang Meng was swept up with his forces.
During Wei's Zhenguang era, Poliuhan Baling overran the frontier garrisons, and Wang Meng was swept up with his forces.
s0006 names 破六汗拔陵, the Six Garrisons rebel Poliuhan Baling; Mohe Chen Bajie is an unrelated misreading of that name.
In the Zhenguang era of Wei, Mohe Chen Bajie attacked and captured the garrison towns, and Meng too was swept up in his host.
In the Zhenguang era of Wei, Poliuhan Baling attacked and captured the garrison towns, and Meng too was swept up in his host.
The literal of s0006 likewise must render 破六汗拔陵 as Poliuhan Baling, not Mohe Chen Bajie.
As vanguard under He Ba Yue he helped capture Moqi Chounu and pacify Qin and Long, often first over the wall and fighting at the fore.
As vanguard under Heba Yue he helped capture Moqi Chounu and pacify Qin and Long, often first over the wall and fighting at the fore.
s0011 has 賀拔岳, the compound surname 賀拔 plus given name 岳; splitting it as He Ba Yue is a naming error.
He escorted Empress Ai, consort of Emperor Wen of Wei, back from the Rouran.
He escorted Empress Dao, consort of Emperor Wen of Wei, back from the Rouran.
s0018 has 悼后; 悼 is the posthumous Dao, not 哀 (Ai).
He welcomed Empress Ai, consort of Emperor Wen of Wei, from the Rouran.
He welcomed Empress Dao, consort of Emperor Wen of Wei, from the Rouran.
The literal of s0018 likewise mistranslates 悼后 as Empress Ai; Empress Dao matches 悼.
Following He Ba Yue as vanguard, he captured Moqi Chounu, pacified Qin and Long, and was often first to scale the walls and fight hard.
Following Heba Yue as vanguard, he captured Moqi Chounu, pacified Qin and Long, and was often first to scale the walls and fight hard.
Literal s0011 repeats the split of 賀拔岳; Heba Yue restores the compound surname.
In the Deposed Emperor's second year he became governor of South Qishan, was raised to Duke of Anning, and his fief reached two thousand households in all.
In the Deposed Emperor's second year he became governor of Nanqi, was raised to Duke of Anning, and his fief reached two thousand households in all.
s0052 has 南岐州刺史: Nanqi is the province name, not South Qishan (岐山).
Even on campaign he gathered Confucian scholars and had them taught the classics and histories.
Even on campaign he gathered Confucian scholars to instruct him in the classics and histories.

s0076 教以書傳 means instruction in the classics, so the original 'had them taught' inverts patient and teacher; the unit does not name Tai as the gatherer, so inserting Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai over-reads 特為太祖所愛 in s0075.
At seventeen he left office and became supernumerary attendant at court, given the added rank general of awesome might.
At seventeen he doffed plain clothes and became supernumerary attendant at court, given the added rank general of awesome might.
s0078 解褐 is doffing plain clothes to take first office, not leaving office.
While Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu held power, he and He Lanxiang—cousins by marriage and friends from youth—planned military and state affairs together.
While Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu held power, he and He Lanxiang—cross-cousins (zhongbiao) and friends from youth—planned military and state affairs together.
s0119 中表 is cross-cousin kinship, not cousins by marriage.
Our late emperor, divinely martial, answered the age; he set the realm right in one stroke; east he conquered, south he cut down, and none who thought of resisting submitted.
Our late emperor, divinely martial, answered the age; he set the realm right in one stroke; east he conquered, south he cut down, and none who thought of resisting went unsubdued.
s0125 無思不服 is a double negative: none who thought of resistance remained unsubmissive; 'none who thought of resisting submitted' reverses that sense.

If you can turn calamity into blessing, deeply recognize what the times require, and ruler and ministers together come bearing coffins and kowtow in submission, then ranks and titles will be removed and you will forever guard the western domains;

If you can turn calamity into blessing, deeply recognize what the times require, and ruler and ministers together come bearing coffins and kowtow in submission, then ranks and titles will be clearly conferred and you will forever guard the western domains;
In s0148 爵等顯除, 除 is appointment and 顯 is 'plainly'; after 輿櫬稽顙 the offer is to confer ranks, not strip them.
Hong and Er counties and made the territory Taozhou.
Honghe, two cities, and made the territory Taozhou.
With s0152 洮陽, s0154 洪和二城 are the two cities Taoyang and Honghe, not counties Hong and Er.
Hong and Er counties, and made the territory Taozhou.
Honghe, two cities, and made the territory Taozhou.
Literal s0154 repeats the split of 洪和二城; Honghe plus 'two cities' restores the toponym.
[In Jiande fifth year Can followed Emperor Wen at Bing Province, fell in battle, and was posthumously made upper grand general and Duke of Qingdu.
[In Jiande fifth year Can followed Gaozu at Bing Province, fell in battle, and was posthumously made upper grand general and Duke of Qingdu.
s0167 高祖 in this Zhou shu note is temple-name Gaozu (Jiande 5), not Emperor Wen.
[In Jiande fifth year, following Emperor Wen at Bing Province, he died in battle, posthumously awarded upper grand general, and posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Qingdu commandery.
[In Jiande fifth year, following Gaozu at Bing Province, he died in battle, posthumously awarded upper grand general, and posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Qingdu commandery.
The literal of s0167 likewise must render 高祖 as Gaozu, not Emperor Wen.
Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai said delightedly: "When the matter is settled, I shall reward you with a fine mouth."
Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai said delightedly: "When the matter is settled, I shall reward you with a fine servant."
s0193 佳口 is a prized dependent; s0194 賜綱侍婢二人 shows the reward was servants, not a body part.
The Grand Progenitor said in delight: "When the matter is settled, I shall reward you with a fine mouth."
The Grand Progenitor said in delight: "When the matter is settled, I shall reward you with a fine servant."
Literal s0193 repeats the body-part reading of 佳口; 'fine servant' matches the sense confirmed in s0194.

Because Empress Ashina was about to enter from the Turks, Chen Gongchun and others had an edict issued summoning Chigang and Grand General Wang Jie to lead troops to welcome and escort her at the frontier.

When Duke of Chen Chun and others were bringing Empress Ashina from the Turks to enter the frontier, an edict summoned Chigang and Grand General Wang Jie to lead troops to welcome and escort her at the frontier.

s0210 陳公純 is Duke of Chen, Chun, not Chen Gongchun, and 詔徵綱與大將軍王傑 is an imperial summons of Gang and Wang Jie, not an edict issued by Chun; the proposed 'in connection with' is awkward and blurs that 陳公純等 belongs with the incoming of 皇后阿史那氏.

Chen Gongchun and others, because Empress Ashina was about to enter the frontier from the Turks, an edict summoned Gang together with Grand General Wang Jie to lead troops to welcome and escort her at the border.

Duke of Chen, Chun, and others, because Empress Ashina was about to enter the frontier from the Turks, an edict summoned Gang together with Grand General Wang Jie to lead troops to welcome and escort her at the border.
Literal s0210 already treats 詔徵 as an edict summoning Gang and Wang Jie; replacing Chen Gongchun with Duke of Chen, Chun matches 陳公純.
Soon he was removed and made governor of Shanwu commandery.
Soon he was appointed governor of Shanwu commandery.
s0229 尋除善無郡守 uses 除 as appointment to office, not removal.
In the third year of Xiaochang, he was again removed and made separate commander, following Changsun Zhi on the western campaign.
In the third year of Xiaochang, he was again appointed separate commander, following Changsun Zhi on the western campaign.
s0230 又除別將 is a further appointment; 除 does not mean he was removed.
He also gave him a daughter of Duke Hui of Shao Yuwen Hao in marriage.
He also gave him a daughter of Duke Hui of Shao in marriage.
s0235 names only 邵惠公女; Yuwen Hao is not in this sentence and should not be interpolated.
At the start of Tianhe, he was removed and made left palace guard, and advanced in rank to grand general.
At the start of Tianhe, he was appointed left palace guard, and advanced in rank to grand general.
s0247 除左宮伯 is appointment as left palace guard, not removal from office.
When Emperor Min of Xiaojing succeeded, he was sent out as governor of He Province, raised to Duke of Shibao, and given a thousand more households.
When Emperor Xiaomin succeeded, he was sent out as governor of He Province, raised to Duke of Shibao, and given a thousand more households.
s0270 孝閔帝 is Emperor Xiaomin; 'Emperor Min of Xiaojing' splits the title and invents Jing.
When Emperor Min of Xiaojing succeeded, he went out as governor of He Province, advanced in nobility to Duke of Shibao county, and given an increased fief of one thousand households.
When Emperor Xiaomin succeeded, he went out as governor of He Province, advanced in nobility to Duke of Shibao county, and was given an increased fief of one thousand households.
Literal s0270 likewise needs Emperor Xiaomin for 孝閔帝, and 'was given' supplies the missing finite verb.
He entered court as junior minister of works, was removed and made governor of Yun Province, and transferred to governor of Ning Province.
He entered court as junior minister of works, was appointed governor of Yun Province, and transferred to governor of Ning Province.
s0274 除雲州刺史 uses 除 as appointment, not removal from the junior ministership.
